question: What condition affects even the wise person at the tip of nectar with its essence?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar.
The essence of juice is involved.
Even a wise person is described as burning.
inference: Therefore even the wise may experience a burning condition at the tip of nectar.
uncertainties: The yogic-physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is not explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise person, at the tip of nectar, is burning with the essence of its juice.
